prereg.confirm_gate: h1 deviation-MAE excl 2021: rung MAE <= v1_MAE + 0.10 AND spearman >= v1 - 0.02; adopt highest qualifying rung (R3>R2>R1)
prereg.final_window: 2022-2026, single scripted run, no decisions taken on it
prereg.overlay_rule: apply iff rho_hat in [0.3,1.2] and |placebo| < rho_hat/2; rho* = clip(0.5*rho_hat, 0, 0.75); dElo = clip(rho**k*x/82, +-25), recentered; never inside backtests
prereg.hetero_rule: keep iff train 80% coverage tertile spread improves vs uniform (result: keep=False)
